skills.name: kitesink-fitness-reference
skills.description: Look up, read and cite entries in the KiteSink fitness reference (kitesink.com/fitness), a sourced field guide to strength training, hypertrophy, powerlifting, conditioning, recovery, nutrition, diet and body composition, plus a list of common claims with verdicts. Use when a question about training or nutrition could be answered from it, or when a user asks what KiteSink says about a topic.

skills.name: kitesink-music-reference
skills.description: Look up, read and cite entries in the KiteSink music field guide (kitesink.com/music), a sourced guide to music rights and royalties (the two copyrights in a song, mechanical royalties and the MLC, unclaimed royalties), plus common claims with verdicts and a dated table of where unclaimed royalties are held and how to claim them. Use when a question about music royalties or rights could be answered from it, or when a user asks what KiteSink says about a topic.
